# Zsolt Farkas — zsoltfrks.xyz

> Personal website and portfolio of Zsolt Farkas, a software engineer and Computer Science BSc student based in Szeged, Hungary. Focused on backend technologies, systems design, and addon development.

## Pages

- [Home](https://zsoltfrks.xyz/): Introduction, projects, work experience, studies, and contact details
- [About](https://zsoltfrks.xyz/about): Longer bio, full tech stack, and photos of Luna the dog

## Projects

- [User Control Panel](https://github.com/zsoltfrks/user-control-panel): Full-stack user management dashboard with authentication and role-based access control (Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL)
- [Healer Mana](https://github.com/zsoltfrks/healer-mana): Customizable World of Warcraft addon that displays healer mana (Lua)
- [DOCX to PDF Merger](https://github.com/zsoltfrks/batch-docx-to-pdf-merger): Automation script that batch-converts DOCX to PDF with page numbering and TOC (Python)
